verdict.rationale: Shortcut publishes an llms.txt at www.shortcut.com/llms.txt that links to markdown help pages, such as a Codex CLI setup guide for the Shortcut MCP server, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Coverage stops short of the developer/API docs, where probes found no llms.txt, no markdown rendering and no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, despite the claim that Swagger/OpenAPI versions exist. Missing for 10: an llms.txt on developer.shortcut.com, markdown versions of the API reference, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at a discoverable path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: [Codex CLI](https://www.shortcut.com/help/integrations/codex-cli.md): Setup guide for connecting Codex CLI to Shortcut through the Shortcut MCP server.
[Jira Import](https://www.shortcut.com/import/jira/): Direct migration path from Jira, plus Trello import and CSV for other tools.
We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
